messages:
alex: Hey, customer CT-491 reporting repeated 504s when calling hosted embeddings stream this morning, ~30% of requests during a 10m window. curl sample below. anyone seen this pattern?

maria: @alex can you paste the curl and trace-id?

alex: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"..."}'
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings/stream

  response: HTTP/2 504
  trace: tx-20260318-8f4b2c

jordan: saw similar earlier today in eu1 — ingress fanout queue grew and authz backend had >200ms p50, p95 spiked to 1.2s. that combination will push edge to early close.

sre-bot: alert: frontdoor-authz-latency spike 2026-03-18T09:12Z — p95 1.2s, dropped requests 4.6% over baseline :warning:

maria: customer repro steps? size of batch? streaming or single shot?

alex: they send streaming, small chunks (~512 tokens) but high concurrency from a single tenant (40 concurrent streams).

eng-frontend: quick note — we recently adjusted auth cache ttl to 15s to reduce stale tokens on some tenants. that change may increase auth backend load under fanout.

jordan: that lines up. short TTL + high concurrency = thundering auth checks. edge will wait on upstream auth and if fanout can't get upstream responses, it triggers 504s / connection resets.

support-lead: short-term mitigation suggestions? customer is P0 (high revenue).

maria: 1) Increase auth cache TTL for the tenant to 2m (config can be set per-tenant). 2) Add client-side retry with exponential backoff (recommended: 3 retries with jitter). 3) Route tenant to a less-loaded frontdoor region if possible.

jordan: ops mitigation: bump authz circuit timeout from 700ms -> 1.5s for 10m window, and temporarily lower ingress fanout concurrency for that tenant to 20. will need a config PR and quick rollout.

eng-frontend: PR ready-ish, posting snippet:
```yaml
edge.auth_cache.ttl_overrides:
  tenant: CT-491
  ttl_seconds: 120
edge.ingress.fanout.max_concurrency.overrides:
  tenant: CT-491
  max: 20
```

deploy-bot: rollout started for config/overrides to eu1-edge (canary 10% -> 100%).

alex: applying TTL override now, will monitor. customer on call in 10m.

sre-bot: metric update: within 2m of TTL bump, authz p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 320ms for CT-491, ingress queue depth halved. 504 rate down to 0.9% from 30%. :thumbsup:

maria: can we add a longer-term fix?

jordan: long-term: increase default auth cache TTL for high-concurrency tenants, add auth token caching in frontdoor (local ephemeral cache), and implement a backpressure signal so ingress fanout throttles before hitting auth backend. also add an automated tenant-slowdown runbook.

support-lead: please file ENG-1268 for follow-up (assign eng-frontend + eng-runtime). I'll update the customer and recommend a short retry strategy while we finish the config.

alex: Customer updated: they saw immediate improvement, will keep us posted. thanks all. :eyes:

eng-frontend: logging note for postmortem: capture edge->auth latency histogram with tenant tag (not currently emitted at p95 granularity).

sre-bot: deploy complete to eu1-edge canary 100% — no rollback.

maria: adding repro command for docs:
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings/stream \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"x"}' | jq -c .
(replicate with 40 parallel streams from same token to stress auth path)

alex: closing thread for now, will reopen if errors resurface.
